a.lede: Attackers have started exploiting a maximum-severity GitLab vulnerability patched earlier this month, according to the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA). [...]
a.title: CISA says max severity GitLab flaw now exploited in the wild

b.lede: Hackers attempted to exploit a critical GitLab vulnerability in Alpine Linux's development infrastructure on October 20-21, prompting the open-source project to rebuild its GitLab server and reset all passwords over concerns of a possible compromise. [...]
b.title: Alpine Linux rebuilds GitLab after attempted RCE attack
